scope: Synthetic local-worker audit-spool admission, stale-owner recovery, and ASGI checks

asgi_lifecycle.exception_handler: error audit completed before reservation release

limits: OS-lock coordination covers local processes sharing one POSIX journal file; multi-container and replica failover are not certified.
Stale reservations are reaped on the next mutation preflight; read-only status can report them before cleanup.
Concurrent read and denial audit events can still consume journal headroom while a mutation is in flight.
No Docker services, PostgreSQL rows, domain data, migrations, or pytest suites were used.
cleanup: Private temporary directory and synthetic journal were removed.
